## Install

**Windows (x64):** run the `-win-x64.exe` installer. It's unsigned, so SmartScreen will warn: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Linux (x64):** download the `.AppImage`, `chmod +x` it and run it, or install the `.deb` with `sudo apt install ./Simple*.deb`.

**macOS (Apple Silicon):**

1. Download the `.dmg`, open it, and drag **Simple PDF** into **Applications**.
2. Open Simple PDF. macOS will say it "cannot verify" the app, because it isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to the Simple PDF message. Confirm with your password.

You only need to do the macOS steps once. Full instructions and a Terminal alternative are in the [README](https://github.com/ddmiller1995/simple-pdf#installing).
